modules.name: Ernest
modules.description: Percussion oscillator with six ways to bend its pitch: kicks, toms, snares, zaps, with decay, bass boost and ring modulation

modules.name: Marcel
modules.description: 8-bit looper / delay with a variable memory clock that slowly forgets: erode, tone, freeze, reverse, and a ring that shows the memory

modules.name: Jules
modules.description: Six linked slopes (envelopes, LFOs, oscillators, chords) with twelve modes, a chance control on the trigger cascade and a poly output

modules.name: Odette
modules.description: Stereo repeater with 8 nested sizes, from plucked strings and flangers to 40-second loops, with drift and ducking

modules.name: Colette
modules.description: A murmuration of up to 32 voices that fly in pitch space, gather, scatter and settle on the notes of a chord: ambient textures that never quite repeat

modules.name: Lucienne
modules.description: Six analog-style cores tied in a ring, tuned by ear: they lock onto just intervals, cross-modulate into chaos, starve on a sagging power rail. Gates opened by an internal register, two resonant filters, a halo, and two asynchronous LFOs crossfaded across twelve destinations

modules.name: Gaston
modules.description: Master sequencer for drum voices: eight trigger lanes with per-step probability and four CV lanes, each with its own length, clock ratio and direction for polyrhythms. Built-in clock with swing and vintage 96 PPQN timing, CDJ-style transport, pads with live recording, and a map of all lanes

modules.name: Gastounet
modules.description: Pattern memory and song expander for Gaston (attach to its left): 4 banks of 16 patterns, Korg-style write and copy, next and random, quantized launch with restart or legato, and a song made of pattern rows
